title: Khali jhula kaise jhulau
body:
Aaja asghar lori sunau..(2)
khali jhula kaise jhulau
Aaja asghar lori sunau
khali jhula kaise jhulau
Aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil se lagau, naaz uthau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kaale gesu, rang sunehra
kitna hasee'n tu, chaand hai mera
khaak o lahu mein, lekin dooba
phoolo jaisa, tera chehra
dhoop mein ran ki, kaise bachau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek ek pehlu, teri khushboo
chaaro taraf hai, mere phaili
tera kurta, tera shaluka
aise basa hai, yaad me meri
jitna sochu, doobti jaau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Chaand se badhkar, tera ujaala
maine safar mein,     tujhko paala
rehgayi hasrat, ghar ke sahan mein
na tu chala aur, na tu khela
ungli pakadkar, tujhko chalau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Akbar mera, pehne sehra
tumko banau, mai shahwala
makhmal jaise, phoolo wala
chhota sa ek, pyaara sehra
sar pe tumhare, beta sajaau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Nazuk se gardan pe tumhari
maine suna hai, zakhm laga hai
kaisa sitam zalim ne kiya hai
tu chhota hai, teer bada hai
roti jaau, kehti jaau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kyu na padhe salman o raza hum
nauhe ke soorat mein lori
lori sunane ki hasrat thi
jo na hui madar ki puri
kehti thi mai, mar na jau
<<MINI>>
aaja asghar lori sunau
